variants.name: default
variants.what: half model 12 x 8 m, CPE8R 0.125 m around the footing, smooth footing coupled to a reference point, pushed 0.2 m

variants.name: rough
variants.what: rough footing (horizontal displacement coupled as well)

variants.name: mc_phi0
variants.what: Mohr-Coulomb with phi = 0 and c = cu (Tresca)

variants.name: direct_bc
variants.what: displacement prescribed on the footing nodes (rough), no reference point: load = sum of reactions

variants.name: cpe4
variants.what: linear CPE4, 0.125 m: 6.3 % below Prandtl (footing effectively half an element short)

variants.name: locking
variants.what: linear triangles CPE3: volumetric locking, +51 % and still climbing

variants.name: force_control
variants.what: 400 kPa pressure on the footing: completes, no collapse

variants.name: small_domain
variants.what: soil layer 0.4 m deep on a rigid base: the failure mechanism is cut off

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, load of the half model reported
